title: On the role of symmetry for staircase mechanisms in local differential privacy efficiency across different privacy regimes
summary: We investigate the structural foundations of statistical efficiency under $α$-local differential privacy, with a focus on maximizing Fisher information. Building on the role of continuous staircase mechanisms, we identify a fundamental symmetry regarding the extremal values $1$ and $e^α$. We demonstrate that when the optimal measure satisfies this symmetry, the Fisher information admits a closed-form expression.
